topic: Data Quality and Signal Loss in B2B Marketing
headline: 96% of B2B marketers use AI, but hiring is moving toward judgment and QA roles
keyNotes: Surprisingly, almost all companies (96%) that sell products or services to other businesses (B2B marketers) are now using smart computer programs, known as AI, to help with their work.
Even with so many businesses using these smart computer programs, the types of jobs companies are looking to fill are changing.
Companies are now focusing on hiring people for 'judgment roles,' which means jobs where human employees need to make important decisions and think critically.

They are also looking for 'QA roles,' which stands for Quality Assurance, meaning jobs where people check the work to make sure it's accurate and of high quality, especially when smart computer programs are involved.
question: If smart computer programs are becoming so common in business, how might that change the most valuable skills you need to develop or look for in your own work or industry?
